lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg6Cu4Sb2 (reduced formula Mg3Cu2Sb) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 12 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies Cu and Sb centers each coordinated by four Mg neighbors, while Mg centers have ten geometric neighbors (six Cu, four Sb). Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows Cu–Mg 4-vertex polyhedra sharing corners and edges, and Mg–Mg 10-vertex polyhedra sharing corners and edges, forming a three-dimensional connected network.
